rca_of_issue: Bug: V2 workouts (source=engine_v2) arrive from /api/workouts/{id} with warmup=null and exercises=[]; their runnable content lives in blocks[]. Guided flow prior to iter115 iterated workout.warmup[] and workout.exercises[] directly → for V2 runs it had zero drills to play AND zero exercises → guided screen stalled on 'PREPARING GUIDED FLOW' or skipped straight to complete. Fix: guided.tsx now runs adaptWorkoutForGuided(w) after the fetch which (a) extracts blocks.find(type==='warmup').drills into workout.warmup[], (b) expands each non-warmup block into a cardio-shaped exercise with duration_sec from block.duration_min*60, logging_type='cardio', and metadata composed of hr_zone/pace_target/power_target/cadence/effort_rpe. Idempotent for V1 (returns unchanged if warmup[] or exercises[] already populated and not marked V2). Empty-workout guard in beginWorkout() bails to detail screen with 'Nothing to guide yet' Alert instead of blank player.
